- July 30, 2026 — Amazon Bedrock Agents Classic is no longer open to new customers. Existing
  customers unaffected; AWS points new users at Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.  [DEPRECATION — not
  reported]
- June 30, 2026 — advance notice of the same availability change.  [deprecation]

No August 2026 entries. No new Bedrock feature, API or resource type this scan.

API reference (APIReference/welcome.html) unchanged: Amazon Bedrock; Agents for Amazon Bedrock (now
Classic); Agents for Amazon Bedrock Runtime (Classic); Data Automation for Amazon Bedrock; Runtime
for Amazon Bedrock Data Automation; Amazon Bedrock Runtime. Both Agents sections now carry the
closed-to-new-customers note.
